{{Top|leg}}
'''Kaffir''' were a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] that were part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Operation Grain Snatch]]. Their part was to replace [[Overlord (Imperial)|Overlord]] [[Ghorin]] stormtrooper transports' workers with theirs who would claim that the Rebels were driven off. This was part of the plan to steal Ghorin's supply of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and replace it was [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] grain.
